title_en: Arrangement of the Supreme People's Court on Mutual Entrustment of Service of Civil and Commercial Judicial Documents Between the Courts of the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

articles.content_en: Article 1 The People's Courts of the Mainland and the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may entrust each other with the service of judicial documents in civil and commercial matters.

Article 2 The entrustment for service of judicial documents by both parties shall be conducted through the Higher People's Courts and the High Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Judicial documents of the Supreme People's Court may be directly entrusted to the High Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for service.

Article 3 The entrusting party requesting service of judicial documents shall issue a letter of entrustment affixed with its seal, and shall specify in the letter of entrustment the name of the entrusting authority, the name of the person to be served, the detailed address, and the nature of the case.
The letter of entrustment shall be submitted in Chinese. If the attached judicial documents are not in Chinese, a Chinese translation shall be provided. The above documents shall be in duplicate. If there are two or more persons to be served, each person shall have two copies.
If the entrusted party considers that the letter of entrustment does not comply with the provisions of this Arrangement, it shall notify the entrusting party and state its objection to the letter of entrustment. If necessary, it may request the entrusting party to supplement materials.

Article 4 Regardless of whether the date or time limit for appearance specified in the judicial documents has expired, the entrusted party shall effect service. The entrusting party shall make the entrustment request within a reasonable time as far as possible.
Upon receiving the letter of entrustment, the entrusted party shall complete service promptly, and in any event no later than two months from the date of receipt of the letter of entrustment.

Article 5 After service of judicial documents, the People's Courts of the Mainland shall issue a certificate of service; the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall issue a certificate of service. The certificate of service shall be affixed with the court seal.
If the entrusted party is unable to effect service, it shall state on the certificate of service the reasons for the impediment to service, the grounds for refusal to accept and the date, and shall promptly return the letter of entrustment and all attached documents.
Article 6 Service of judicial documents shall be carried out in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the law of the place where the entrusted party is located.
Article 7 The entrusted party shall bear no legal liability for the content and legal consequences of the judicial documents entrusted to it for service.

Article 8 The costs of entrusted service of judicial documents shall be mutually exempted. However, the costs incurred from service by a specific method requested in the letter of entrustment shall be borne by the entrusting party.

Article 9 Judicial documents in this Arrangement include, in the Mainland: copies of the statement of prosecution, copies of the statement of appeal, power of attorney, summons, judgment, mediation document, ruling, decision, notice, certificate of service; in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: copies of the statement of prosecution, copies of the statement of appeal, summons, pleadings, affidavits, written judgment, judgment, order, notice, court order, certificate of service. The above entrusted judicial documents shall be based on the exchanged samples of judicial documents.

Article 10 Any issues encountered during the implementation of this Arrangement and any amendments to it shall be resolved through consultation between the Supreme People's Court and the High Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
29 March 1999
